notes: 15q11.2 imprinting centre; maternally methylated. Hypermethylation (paternal loss) -> PWS; hypomethylation (maternal loss) -> AS.
11p15.5 imprinting centre 1; paternally methylated. Gain -> BWS; loss -> SRS (commonest SRS cause).
11p15.5 imprinting centre 2; maternally methylated. Loss of methylation -> BWS (commonest BWS cause).
6q24 PLAGL1/HYMAI DMR; maternally methylated. Hypomethylation/paternal UPD6 -> TNDM.
DLK1-MEG3 IG-DMR; paternally methylated. Loss -> Temple syndrome; gain -> Kagami-Ogata syndrome.
GNAS complex locus; aberrant methylation -> pseudohypoparathyroidism spectrum (report as aberrant).
7q32 MEST DMR; maternally methylated. Hypomethylation / maternal UPD7 -> SRS.
7p12 GRB10 DMR; associated with UPD7-related SRS.
